headword: {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め
gloss: stir-fried meat and vegetables; meat and vegetable stir-fry

definitions.gloss: stir-fried meat and vegetables; meat and vegetable stir-fry

examples.japanese: {今晩|こんばん}は{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have stir-fried meat and vegetables tonight.

examples.japanese: {定食屋|ていしょくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered stir-fried meat and vegetables at the set-meal restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}れば→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you make stir-fried meat and vegetables with leftover vegetables and pork from the fridge, you can easily have a nutritionally balanced meal.

notes:
A straightforward compound describing a common home-cooked and restaurant dish: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) + ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables) + ⟦{炒|いた}め→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ (stir-fry). It is a staple of everyday Japanese cooking and appears frequently on ⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧ (set meal) menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧: stir-fried meat and vegetables set meal
- {豚|ぶた}{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め: pork and vegetable stir-fry
- {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make meat and vegetable stir-fry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野菜炒|やさいいた}め→野菜炒め：14803_yasaiitame⟧: vegetable stir-fry (without meat)
- {回鍋肉|ホイコーロー}: twice-cooked pork (Chinese-style stir-fry; more specific dish with doubanjiang sauce)
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: fried noodles (also a stir-fried dish, but with noodles as the base)

REGISTER:
This is an everyday cooking term. On restaurant menus, it may also appear as ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧{肉炒|にくいた}め (with the order reversed).
